newsitem.title: FRANCE: French stocks seen starting softer.
newsitem.headline: French stocks seen starting softer.

text.p: French shares were expected to open lower on the first day of the new account, reflecting weakness in domestic and German bond markets, traders said.
The blue-chip CAC-40 index closed down 12.40 points or 0.48 percent at 2,562.84. The CAC-40 futures contract on GLOBEX was down 15 at 2,562 from Friday's close.
* Today also marks entry of AGF, Bic and Valeo into the CAC-40 index.
* Saint-Louis expected to be busy with Worms merger.
* Club Med rises in grey market.
* Eurotunnel says lending banks agree an extension of its debt standstill until December 14 from March 14.
